description: Reviewed facts that the locks cannot supply. tools/generate-sbom.py applies them to THIRD-PARTY-INVENTORY.json, and tools/test_third_party.py fails when the inventory, SBOM or notices disagree with this file. Record a licence only from the upstream licence file or an upstream statement; otherwise use NOASSERTION with license_status unverified and say what to check.

not_shipped.name: @napi-rs/canvas
not_shipped.reason: Optional Node canvas for pdfjs-dist. The browser builds use the text-only PDF path and do not bundle it; its platform binaries are excluded so the inventory does not depend on the machine that generated it.

not_shipped.name: pywin32
not_shipped.reason: Installed only on Windows, as a dependency of portalocker. The server image runs on Linux and does not contain it.

not_shipped.name: tzdata
not_shipped.reason: Installed only on Windows (sys_platform == 'win32' in apps/server/uv.lock). The server image runs on Linux and does not contain it.

license_corrections.name: colorama
license_corrections.reason: The metadata declares no licence field; the distributed LICENSE.txt of 0.4.6 is the 3-clause BSD licence.

license_corrections.name: python-dateutil
license_corrections.reason: The metadata says Dual License. The distributed LICENSE of 2.9.0.post0 applies the 3-clause BSD licence to all code and Apache-2.0 to contributions after 1 December 2017, so both apply.

license_corrections.name: pywin32
license_corrections.reason: The metadata says PSF, but the distributed licence files of 312 combine a BSD-style licence (win32, com, pythonwin), LGPL 2.1 (adodbapi), MIT (MAPIStubLibrary), the Scintilla licence and the PSF licence (idle). No single expression was verified.

license_corrections.name: tzdata
license_corrections.reason: Windows only, so a Linux run finds no metadata. The 2026.3 distribution declares License: Apache-2.0 and ships the Apache licence file.

license_corrections.name: wrapt
license_corrections.reason: The metadata says BSD; the distributed LICENSE of 1.17.3 is the 2-clause BSD licence.

data.name: EcoLogits model, provider and electricity data
data.note: Converted from the pinned EcoLogits release (packages/ecologits-core/upstream/lock.json) and distributed under MPL-2.0 with the port. The server uses the same data through the EcoLogits Python package. The entries marked as part of this data name the sources EcoLogits credits.

data.name: Our World in Data electricity mix
data.supplier: Our World in Data (Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Rosado)
data.part_of: EcoLogits model, provider and electricity data
data.note: Electricity-mix carbon intensity. Our World in Data states that data it republishes from third parties stays under the original authors' terms.

data.name: ADEME Base Empreinte electricity factors
data.part_of: EcoLogits model, provider and electricity data
data.note: Abiotic resource depletion and primary energy factors of electricity. Licence not recorded here; check the Base Empreinte terms of use.

data.name: World Resources Institute electricity water data
data.part_of: EcoLogits model, provider and electricity data
data.note: Water consumed to generate electricity (off-site WUE). Licence not recorded here; check the WRI publication terms.

data.name: OpenRouter model statistics
data.part_of: EcoLogits model, provider and electricity data
data.note: Time to first token and output speed in the EcoLogits model records. Licence not recorded here.

data.name: ML.ENERGY Leaderboard measurements behind the EcoLogits regressions
data.part_of: EcoLogits model, provider and electricity data
data.note: EcoLogits ships regression coefficients fitted to these measurements, not the measurements themselves. Licence not recorded here: the leaderboard repository (https://github.com/ml-energy/leaderboard) had no licence file when checked on 9 September 2026.

data.name: BoaviztAPI server impact data
data.part_of: EcoLogits model, provider and electricity data
data.note: Server embodied impacts and non-GPU server power, as values in the EcoLogits data. No BoaviztAPI software is included. Licence of the values not recorded here.

data.name: Lees-Perasso et al. GPU life-cycle study
data.part_of: EcoLogits model, provider and electricity data
data.note: GPU embodied impacts. Published figures cited by EcoLogits; licence not recorded here.

data.name: Jegham et al. video generation figures
data.part_of: EcoLogits model, provider and electricity data
data.note: Video generation durations and server power. Published figures cited by EcoLogits; licence not recorded here.

data.name: Schneider et al. TPU embodied carbon figures
data.part_of: EcoLogits model, provider and electricity data
data.note: TPU embodied carbon. Published figures cited by EcoLogits; licence not recorded here.

data.name: EcoLogits reference coefficients for the archived Original method
data.note: Coefficients and default settings copied from the pinned EcoLogits source for the archived Original method, which the product no longer offers. The data still ships in the estimator bundle.

data.name: cl100k_base BPE ranks
data.note: Vocabulary shipped inside the MIT-licensed gpt-tokenizer package. It reproduces the cl100k_base encoding that OpenAI publishes with tiktoken (MIT); that notice is kept in packages/tokenizers/LICENSES. No separate licence for the rank files themselves is recorded.

data.name: o200k_base BPE ranks
data.note: Vocabulary shipped inside the MIT-licensed gpt-tokenizer package. It reproduces the o200k_base encoding that OpenAI publishes with tiktoken (MIT); that notice is kept in packages/tokenizers/LICENSES. No separate licence for the rank files themselves is recorded.
